newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says inflation 6.47 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says inflation 6.47 pct in 1996.

text.p: Indonesia's Coordinating Minister of Economic and Finance Saleh Afiff said inflation was 6.47 percent in the 1996 calendar year, compared with 8.64 percent in 1995.

"Our monetary policy has produced good results. Inflation was 6.47 percent in 1996, compared with 8.64 percent in 1995," he told a briefing ahead of President Suharto's 1997/98 budget speech to parliament.
Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said the government had targeted inflation at 6.0 percent in fiscal 1997/98 (April/March).
Afiff said Indonesia's consumer price index rose 0.55 percent in December, compared with a rise of 0.57 percent in November and 0.79 percent in December 1995.
